name: pali-canon
description: Read and study the Pāli Canon: the whole Tipiṭaka offline, any citation or PTS page, English translations with mirrors, Pāli dictionary.
long_description: Bundles the complete Pāli Tipiṭaka (VRI Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana edition) for offline reading, citation lookup (MN 10, SN 56:11, Dhp 183, Pj 1, M i 55…), PTS page lookup and full-text Pāli search. English translations by Ṭhānissaro Bhikkhu (dhammatalks.org) and Access to Insight are fetched live with official mirrors; Digital Pāḷi Dictionary lookups are live. Numbering differences between editions are reported. Texts keep their own licences (non-commercial).
